title: Traditional Moroccan Lentil Stew (Bissara)
description: A hearty and comforting North African stew made with lentils and spices, often served as a side dish or light meal.

ingredients.name: moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, salt, and 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the bissara, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
